evidence.observation: Pressure 3.014 Torr at growth start, in line with the ~3.00 Torr seen at 100 sccm during the ramp.
Pressure rose steadily to 3.251 Torr (3.074, 3.12, 3.19, 3.251), about 0.06 Torr per event, with no sign of levelling off.
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm (99.4-101.0), so the rise is not caused by more gas going in.
Temperature held at 750 °C with steady heater power (~45%), so the thermal side looks normal.
No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so I can't check for air getting in. That rules out telling a seal leak from an exhaust blockage, and the atmosphere required for growth can't be confirmed.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or a check such as a leak-up (rate-of-rise) test or stepping the Ar flow to see how pressure responds, would show whether this is air leaking in (seal leak) or the exhaust being restricted (blockage). Characterization of the sample isn't available yet.
